verdict.rationale: E2B publishes concrete documented concurrency limits (up to 100 concurrently running sandboxes, up to 24-hour session length on Pro plans) and metrics/CLI tooling to manage fleets, giving platform engineers real numbers to plan around. However missing for 10: no documentation of how limits scale for enterprise/self-hosted deployments, no guidance on requesting higher concurrency, no independent/hands-on benchmarks validating fleet behavior at scale, and no discussion of failure modes or queuing when limits are hit.
